title: Link styles and the main button work on every Spotlight theme

source.ref: Follow-up to LIVE-2486 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): the setting must work whatever theme a member picks.

detail: LIVE-2486 made New World honour each link's style. Every other Spotlight theme (Services, Temple, Designer, Free Human, Network, Bold, Wildheart, Nocturne, CyberWitch, Mindless) still drew every link as a card, and the kit themes made the first link the main button even when the owner picked Text link. One shared module (lib/spotlight/door-style.ts) now holds the rules: a link's own style beats the Links block default, the main button is the Button block, else the link marked main, else the first link drawn as neither a text link nor a card, and that link is not drawn again as a door. Each layout draws text links as one centred underlined row in the theme's own colour, buttons with its own secondary button, and cards as before (components/spotlight/door-runs.tsx). CyberWitch and Mindless keep their own sticker button until a link is marked main.

verify.note: Fails while any Spotlight theme ignores the link styles or makes a text link the main button.
